checks.finding: Each design decision states a rationale. The split of TEST-018/TEST-019 across loop-consistency and loop-escalation is justified in Design Decisions by decision doc §3.1 and INV-005. 'No ninth loop' rests on the shared quality-gate lifecycle. The capability-only emit-run-record usage error is justified by v2 consumers reading `effort`. block_id is adopted now because A5's enum exists. The golden-baseline path follows the existing per-feature verification/ convention. capability_applicability starts on quality-gate only because of WFI-011 evidence limits. F7/F8 are N/A because no Foundation epic produces those states.

OQ-001 to OQ-003 are resolved. OQ-004 names an owner (the A7 spec/task-plan owner, with T-005, T-006 and T-007 owning their shares), and states 'Blocks Implementation: yes' for accepting T-005 to T-007 as complete or Done. Its Resolution Path is concrete: verify TEST-009, the four TEST-026 branches in both runtimes and the TEST-018/TEST-019 traces, then record closure in a non-frozen verification addendum. The historical unsatisfied wording is explicitly superseded.

investigation.md is present and the design cites INV-001 to INV-024 throughout. The Assumptions section defers to requirements.md and covers the unmerged state of epics A1 to A6, ADR-0010/0016/0023 and the jq/bash/PowerShell runtimes. The unmerged-epic claim carries a re-verification instruction (re-verify before Phase 2/3; AC-035 fingerprint-drift hard-fail), which satisfies WFI-013. Limitation: I did not independently verify against the live tree that A1 to A6 are still unmerged, because only admitted inputs may be read.

design.md has a `## Constraint Compliance` table covering the no-new-loop and no-new-suite constraints, the assert_artifacts_schema/assert_terminal lock (AC-009), the emit-run-record v1 byte-identity (AC-011), SKIP auditability (REQ-007), PROJECT_CONTEXT_INVALID distinguishability, golden-baseline governance and fingerprint drift. The Compatibility Matrix dispositions agree with requirements AC-005, AC-007, AC-019 to AC-021, AC-028, AC-042 and AC-043. Minor advisory, non-blocking: the Data Plan's jsonc manifest example lists only AC-004, AC-007, AC-021, AC-042 and AC-043. requirements AC-034 also names AC-019, AC-020, AC-036, AC-037 and the Context-present REQ-003 assertions. Test Strategy item 8 says the manifest enumerates A1 to A6. The example is not labelled illustrative, so an implementer should treat AC-034 as the authoritative list.
No performance requirements found in requirements.md (no latency, throughput or concurrency thresholds). This is a test-infrastructure specification.

The Deployment / CI Plan section exists. It states no CI change in this task and names the Phase 2/3 registration surfaces: tests/run-all.sh, tests/run-all.ps1 and .github/workflows/test.yml, following the INV-005 pattern. CI runs only the read-only capture default and never the --write-candidate or promote commands. The AC-031 live-model refresh test is non-gating. Feature flags and migration ordering do not apply, because there are no schema or data changes and the feature is test-only.

The Data Plan states no persisted data entities and no existing data affected. The Migration Strategy says no migration is required, because every proposed field is additive and optional with a backward-compatible default (capability_applicability absent-safe, the emit_capability flag, net-new schemas). AC-008 and AC-011 verify backward compatibility.

The External Integrations section states None; every target is internal to the repository. Cross-epic dependencies (A1 to A6) are modelled through the REQ-007 allowlist manifest, with source, line_range, sha256 digest and activation_condition. Their failure behaviour is defined as SKIP or hard-fail (AC-035).

Every goal REQ-001 to REQ-007 maps to a design element: the REQ-001 target inventory, the structural seam and corpus, the trace schema with six kinds, the fixture matrix and builder, the baseline capture/promote scripts, and the SKIP allowlist. No component lacks a requirement. The design-system contract is absent, and design.md states N/A for Design System Compliance. The Technical Summary phrase 'exactly the four files' is authoring-time wording; the Layer Specifications section and the amendment notes disclose the later additions.

The security-relevant surface (golden-baseline integrity, B1) has concrete validation paths. AC-040/TEST-040 is a static scan of test.yml for the literal promote-golden-baseline.sh and --write-candidate strings. AC-041 runs two negative runtime fixtures (CI set; --approved-by omitted). AC-002 is a negative self-check. AC-035 is a hard-fail on dependency-present SKIP, unknown SKIP and fingerprint drift. TEST-026 covers the Done-transition branches in both runtimes. AC-033 has a golden negative test for the capability-only usage error.

SKIP: launch-control observation records domain/context-map.md and domain/domain-contract.json as absent (domain_status: skipped), so no Approved domain model exists. design-system/ is likewise not applicable.
